# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

The instructions for AI tools in this repository are in `AGENTS.md` at
the repository root; read and follow them. If this file and `AGENTS.md`
disagree, `AGENTS.md` wins. The main points:

- Run the build and the tests listed in `AGENTS.md` before calling a
  change done.
- One topic per pull request; ask before going beyond about 300 changed
  lines.
- Substantial changes to core functionality (models, likelihood,
  optimiser, statistics, input or output formats) must be tied to an
  issue.
- Never open, paste or upload patient-derived data, unpublished data or
  unpublished manuscript text.
- Agents open draft pull requests only; a person does the rest.
- Pull request descriptions carry the AI-assistance line given in
  `AGENTS.md`.
- Write in plain, short English.
